footprint.retention_note: raw forward data is never deleted in this phase; a continuous capture needs either a larger volume or an explicit raw-short / aggregate-long retention policy before it can run for weeks

storage_capacity.reconstruction_note: free disk was not sampled at capture time; the start figure is free-now plus the bytes this capture wrote, which is a reconstruction and is labelled as one
storage_capacity.verdict_meaning: STORAGE_CAPACITY_OK carries a week of headroom; TIGHT fits the week but needs attention; BLOCKER means under a day, so 24/7 collection must not be claimed on this volume

resources.memory_measurement: process working set / max RSS via stdlib
resources.disk_measurement: sum of segment file sizes on disk, measured at sample time
resources.network_measurement: sum of decoded WebSocket/HTTP payload bytes

isolation.note: the collector writes append-only JSONL under reports/microstructure-forward/ and touches no trading module; it cannot change a decision, a risk check or an execution path
